column7: The single_writer census fingerprint covered the fence triggers, every trigger definition on a covered table and the fence functions, but not the functions the store migration triggers on covered tables execute (role_permissions/permissions generation, secret_nodes cache epoch and suspend marker, system_metadata retention anchor). Those run in the writing session, the server tagged one included, so a function owner who replaced one changed what runs inside fenced writes with no catalog change the poller compared, and the guard kept vouching. Fixed by fingerprinting the pg_proc row (body md5, settings, security definer, xmin) of every function a non-internal trigger on a covered table executes. Red on real Postgres for all five migration triggers (identical re-create), green with the fix. Found by REVIEW-SOLEWRITER-1.
